title: Executive - Warehouse Operations - Cold Chain
description:
Warehouse Operations
 - Execute inbound and outbound warehouse operations including receiving, unloading, put-away, picking, packing, labeling, and dispatch. 
 - Ensure timely processing and fulfillment of customer orders. 
 - Support efficient storage and material movement within the warehouse. 
 - Coordinate vehicle loading/unloading and dispatch activities. 
 Inventory Management
 - Update inventory transactions accurately in WMS/ERP systems. 
 - Assist in cycle counts, stock audits, and inventory reconciliation activities. 
 - Monitor stock movement and report inventory discrepancies or damages. 
 - Ensure proper stock arrangement and material handling practices. 
 Documentation & Reporting
 - Maintain operational documents such as GRN, dispatch records, stock transfer records, and inventory reports. 
 - Prepare daily productivity and operational MIS reports. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate system updates for warehouse transactions. 
 Coordination & Communication
 - Coordinate with inventory, transport, and customer service teams for smooth operational execution. 
 - Escalate operational delays, shortages, or process issues to supervisors. 
 - Support customer-specific operational and reporting requirements. 
 Compliance & Safety
 - Follow warehouse SOPs, quality standards, and safety guidelines. 
 - Ensure proper housekeeping and safe storage practices. 
 - Support warehouse audits and compliance checks. 
 Process Improvement Support
 - Identify operational bottlenecks and support process improvement initiatives. 
 - Participate in productivity and efficiency enhancement activities.
